title: Zesty Japanese Pork Dumplings
description: Mustardy, bouncy-qq dumplings made quick with a mortar and pestle touch, perfect for a sattvic-friendly Japanese snack or lunch.
instructions: In a large bowl combine ground pork with soy sauce, mirin, rice vinegar, sesame oil, minced garlic, grated ginger, sliced scallions, salt, and pepper; mix until fully incorporated.
Grind the mixture through a mortar and pestle to create a smooth, moist paste.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat and lightly oil the surface.
Place a wonton wrapper on the skillet and spoon about 1 tablespoon of the pork mixture onto the center; spread to fill the wrapper.
Add a splash of water to the skillet to create steam and seal the edges of the dumpling by pinching them together.
Cook for 3-4 minutes until the bottom is golden brown and the wrapper is translucent.
Flip the dumpling and steam for another 2 minutes until the pork is fully cooked.
Repeat steps 4-7 with remaining wrappers and filling.
Serve hot with a dipping sauce of soy sauce mixed with a dash of sesame oil and a pinch of chili flakes.
